name: Poland

authorities.competent_authority: URPL (Office for Registration of Medicinal Products, Medical Devices and Biocidal Products); the President of URPL issues the decision. New applications are submitted through CTIS.
authorities.ethics: Ethics assessment under the ethics structure set by the Polish Clinical Trials Act of 9 March 2023; it covers the relevant Part I ethical aspects and the Part II aspects and forms part of the basis for the URPL decision. The National Bioethics Committee for Clinical Trials (NKB) publishes the current good practices for its reviewing teams (2026 set; earlier guidance, including on participant remuneration, revoked).
authorities.compensation_fund: Clinical Trials Compensation Fund, operated through the Patient Rights Ombudsman: sponsor payment for each application for authorisation (from 14 April 2023, including low-intervention trials); participants must be informed of their right to seek a benefit from the Fund.
authorities.fee: National application fee under the Clinical Trials Act; proof of payment to the Medical Research Agency account is uploaded in CTIS (NKB). URPL and NKB publish current payment instructions; amounts are not copied here.
authorities.legal_framework: Regulation (EU) No 536/2014, supplemented by the Polish Clinical Trials Act (consolidated text Journal of Laws 2026 item 2), which sets the national procedure, ethics structure, insurance rules, fees and the Compensation Fund.

language_rules.rule: The CTR Q&A v7.3 (July 2026) Annex II marks Poland as requiring a national-language version of the protocol synopsis, patient-facing documents submitted in Part II, labelling and relevant CTIS application fields. Every PIS, ICF and other participant-facing material is in Polish at submission. Administrative EU templates may be completed in English; then check whether participant-facing content is embedded in them and whether a Poland-specific field needs Polish.
language_rules.form_answers: Part II forms (shared EU templates in content/eu/templates/part-ii) are answered in Polish, matching the Polish variable sheet supplied with CTIS_PL; English is possible for administrative documents (DECISIONS.md D1).
language_rules.communication_support: Inability to write is not inability to understand Polish; language or communication support needed for another reason is addressed in addition to the witness route. The guides set no further national rule for people who do not understand Polish.

study_facts_country_specific.population.pregnant_or_breastfeeding: Are pregnant or breastfeeding participants intentionally enrolled (Article 33; payment limited to expenses and loss of earnings)?
study_facts_country_specific.consent.alternative_recording_method: Is a specific alternative consent-recording method (for example audiovisual recording of oral consent) planned for people who cannot write? It must be described in K1 before use.

documents.name_en: Recruitment arrangements and informed consent procedure

template.basis: European Commission Recruitment and informed consent procedure template v2.0 (adopted January 2026; applies to new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026). URPL also accepts the complete required information in another format that meets the EU regulation and the Polish Act.

documents.content: How potential participants are identified, the first act of recruitment, who approaches them, and how informed consent is provided and obtained. Every consent pathway in the plan (incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness, emergency) needs its section completed with the Poland-specific fields. Must reflect the actual Polish workflow.
documents.note: Sponsor or applicant document; not signed by participants at CTIS submission. Give it a controlled sponsor version and date.

national_fields.v105: Poland: in Polish, state how each recruitment item (K2) is used and how responses from people who are not eligible are handled; that material shown to potential participants in Poland is in Polish; who makes first contact and how personal data are accessed during pre-screening, consistent with K2; for healthy volunteers, how they are identified and approached.
national_fields.v108: Poland: in Polish, state that the Polish PIS and ICF are used; that written consent is dated and signed by the participant (or legally designated representative) and by the person conducting the consent interview on the approved version before enrolment or any trial-specific procedure, except under Article 35; that the participant or representative receives a copy; the PIS/ICF versions and dates referenced (identical to the uploaded L1 documents); that information before consent explains the right to seek a benefit from the Clinical Trials Compensation Fund and the mandatory civil liability insurance of the sponsor and investigator (Patient Rights Ombudsman); that optional choices are separate from main participation; and that trial consent is not presented as the GDPR legal basis for processing.
national_fields.v110: Poland, when incapacitated adults are included: in Polish, describe how incapacity for the trial decision is assessed and by whom; how the legally designated representative is identified and how their legal authority under Polish law is verified and documented at the site (family relationship alone is not legal authority; no generic hierarchy of relatives); which Polish documents the representative and the participant receive; how the participant's understanding and opinion are sought and an explicit refusal or withdrawal is respected; whether and when capacity is reassessed and how personal consent is obtained if capacity returns; how signatures and copies are managed; that only expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation are compensated.
national_fields.v114: Poland, when minors are included: in Polish, state the age groups, which document each group receives and who signs: under 13 the legal representative gives consent and the child receives age-appropriate information without a consent signature; from the 13th birthday until 18 the minor's own written consent is required together with the legal representative's consent (NKB good practice); age ranges are written in NKB notation ("13-18 lat" = has reached 13, has not reached 18). Where both parents hold parental authority, state how the joint parental decision is documented (both parents sign, or one parent signs with an attestation that the consent results from a joint decision with the other parent) and how authority is verified where only one person holds it or another legal arrangement applies. State that information is given by staff trained or experienced in working with minors; that an explicit refusal or withdrawal by a minor able to form an opinion is respected (Article 32), with guardianship-court involvement where Polish law provides it if minor and representative disagree; how verbal or behavioural dissent of younger children is handled; that the adolescent form is used when a child reaches 13 during the trial and adult re-consent is obtained at 18; and that optional secondary-use choices are made by the person legally entitled at that age.
national_fields.v117: Poland, when an impartial witness may be needed: in Polish, state that a participant or legally designated representative who can decide but cannot write gives consent by an approved alternative means in the presence of at least one impartial witness, who signs and dates the ICF (Article 29 CTR; NKB good practice); that the two-witness rule for certain medical experiments does not apply to CTR trials (Article 29b of the Act on the professions of physician and dentist); how the witness is selected and impartiality supported; that an interpreter is not automatically the witness; and, if planned, the alternative recording method (for example audiovisual recording of oral consent), what the witness observes and how the record is retained and protected.
national_fields.v121: Poland, when emergency enrolment is used: in Polish, describe the clinical circumstances that trigger Article 35; who confirms that the participant cannot consent or receive prior information; why the legally designated representative cannot be informed and consent within the therapeutic window; how a known prior objection is checked; how the emergency decision and its timing are documented; which Polish documents are used after the intervention; how consent for continued participation is sought without undue delay (who is contacted, how failed contact attempts are recorded); re-consent if the participant regains capacity; and what happens, including to data already collected, if subsequent consent is refused.

documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja K. Dokument obowiązkowy. Dokument dla organów, nie dla uczestnika: odpowiedzi w tym formularzu po polsku (język pakietu; patrz DECISIONS.md, D1). Bez podpisu przy składaniu wniosku; nadać kontrolowaną wersję i datę sponsora. Podstawa: szablon Komisji Europejskiej „Recruitment and informed consent procedure” w wersji 2.0 (obowiązuje dla nowych zgłoszeń części II od 1 września 2026 r.); URPL przyjmuje także pełne wymagane informacje w innym formacie zgodnym z rozporządzeniem UE i polską ustawą. Wypełnić sekcję każdej ścieżki zgody przewidzianej w planie (dorośli niezdolni do wyrażenia zgody, małoletni, bezstronny świadek, sytuacja nagła), a dla pozostałych zaznaczyć „Nie”. W polach dotyczących przepisów państwa członkowskiego wpisać polskie uzupełnienia z national_fields: próg 13 lat i wspólna decyzja rodziców (NKB), jeden bezstronny świadek (art. 29 CTR, NKB), weryfikacja umocowania przedstawiciela prawnego, procedura z art. 35, informacja o Funduszu Kompensacyjnym Badań Klinicznych i obowiązkowym ubezpieczeniu OC sponsora i badacza. Opis musi odpowiadać rzeczywistemu przebiegowi w polskich ośrodkach oraz wersjom i datom dokumentów K2 i L1.

documents.trigger_text: Recruitment advertisements, letters, digital content or other materials used to recruit participants.
documents.content: Final proposed version that will be used after authorisation, in Polish. No promise of benefit, no minimising of risk, payment not used in a way that could distort the decision; target population and study purpose match the authorised trial. How the material is used and how responses from people who are not eligible are handled are explained in the application (K1).
documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja K. Warunkowy: dla każdego materiału rekrutacyjnego (ogłoszenie, list, treści cyfrowe, inne). Po polsku. Bez podpisu; załączyć ostateczną proponowaną wersję, która będzie używana po uzyskaniu pozwolenia. Nie obiecywać korzyści, nie umniejszać ryzyka i nie eksponować płatności w sposób, który mógłby zniekształcić decyzję. Populacja docelowa i cel badania zgodne z protokołem. Sposób użycia materiału i postępowanie z odpowiedziami osób niekwalifikujących się opisać w K1; kto nawiązuje pierwszy kontakt i jak uzyskuje się dostęp do danych osobowych przy wstępnej kwalifikacji – spójnie z K1.

documents.name_en: Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form, one set per population
documents.template_note: Templates per population_sets (adult_patients, healthy_volunteers and the population-specific sets of PL-L1-POPULATION).
documents.signature_rule: Blank controlled document in CTIS. At consent, the participant (or legally designated representative) and the person conducting the consent interview sign and date the approved version; the participant or representative receives a copy (Article 29). The impartial-witness route changes the signature record.
documents.content: Blank Polish PIS (SIS in CTIS terminology) and ICF for each population enrolled in Poland. Must contain the Polish Clinical Trials Compensation Fund and insurance information, distinguish main participation from optional choices, use the correct signature route, cover all Polish sites and contacts, and match K1.
documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja L. Dokument obowiązkowy: czysta (niepodpisana) polska informacja dla uczestnika (PIS, w CTIS: SIS) i formularz świadomej zgody (ICF) dla każdej populacji włączanej w Polsce. Uczestnik i osoba prowadząca rozmowę nie podpisują egzemplarza składanego w CTIS; podpisują i datują zatwierdzoną wersję przy uzyskiwaniu zgody, a uczestnik otrzymuje kopię. Obowiązkowo: informacja o prawie do ubiegania się o świadczenie z Funduszu Kompensacyjnego Badań Klinicznych oraz o obowiązkowym ubezpieczeniu odpowiedzialności cywilnej sponsora i badacza (brzmienie zalecane przez Rzecznika Praw Pacjenta). Udział w głównym badaniu oddzielić od wyborów opcjonalnych i wyjaśnić skutki odmowy. Świadoma zgoda na udział nie jest podstawą prawną przetwarzania danych wg RODO. Szablon według population_sets.

documents.trigger: population.minors or population.adults_without_capacity or consent.emergency_enrolment or consent.impartial_witness_possible or pregnancy.participant_follow_up_beyond_main_consent or pregnancy.partner_follow_up or samples.future_use_outside_protocol or data.future_use_outside_protocol
documents.trigger_text: The population or use case changes the consent pathway: minors, limited-capacity adults, emergency enrolment, an impartial witness, pregnancy follow-up, optional future or secondary use.
documents.template_note: Templates per population_sets (minors, adults_without_capacity, emergency, impartial_witness, pregnancy_participant, pregnancy_partner, secondary_use) and population_rules.
documents.content: Separate or adapted Polish documents where the population or use case changes the consent pathway. Minors follow the national 13-year threshold for the minor's own consent in addition to the legal representative's consent.
documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja L. Warunkowy: dla każdej populacji lub sytuacji, która zmienia ścieżkę zgody (małoletni, dorośli niezdolni do wyrażenia zgody, włączenie w sytuacji nagłej, bezstronny świadek, obserwacja ciąży uczestniczki lub partnerki uczestnika, opcjonalne przyszłe lub wtórne wykorzystanie). Po polsku, w wersji czystej. Małoletni: poniżej 13 lat zgodę wyraża przedstawiciel ustawowy, a dziecko otrzymuje informację dostosowaną do wieku bez podpisu zgody; od ukończenia 13 do ukończenia 18 lat wymagana jest zgoda małoletniego i przedstawiciela ustawowego (NKB). Przedziały wieku zapisywać zgodnie z praktyką NKB („13–18 lat” = ukończone 13, nieukończone 18). Wspólna decyzja rodziców: podpis obojga rodziców albo podpis jednego z nich z oświadczeniem o wspólnej decyzji z drugim rodzicem. Bezstronny świadek: wystarczy jeden świadek, który podpisuje i datuje formularz; nie dodawać drugiej linii podpisu świadka. Szablony według population_sets i population_rules.

documents.trigger_text: Other materials given to participants as part of the Part II participant information package.
documents.content: Polish for material that the participant must read or use. A document that merely records study data and is never participant-facing is not translated solely because it exists in the trial master file.
documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja L. Warunkowy: inne materiały przekazywane uczestnikom jako część pakietu informacyjnego części II. Po polsku, jeżeli uczestnik ma je czytać lub z nich korzystać; bez podpisu. Nie tłumaczyć dokumentów, które jedynie rejestrują dane badania i nie są przeznaczone dla uczestnika.

documents.name_en: Polish translations of patient-facing documents (endpoint-related questionnaires, diaries, cards)
documents.trigger_text: Translated patient-facing documents submitted in Part II according to national language rules (CTR Q&A v7.3, Annex II marks Poland as requiring a national-language version). The English source goes with the protocol in Part I (D4_Patient-facing document_<type>_ENG).
documents.note: Only material the participant reads or uses; not every operational document in the trial master file.
documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja R (dokumenty dla pacjenta). Warunkowy: polskie tłumaczenia dokumentów dla pacjenta związanych z punktami końcowymi (kwestionariusze, dzienniczki, karty). Wersja angielska należy do części I (D4_Patient-facing document_<type>_ENG). Tłumaczenie z kontrolą lingwistyczną i kliniczną przed złożeniem; terminologia spójna z PIS/ICF i polskim streszczeniem protokołu.

template.basis: Optional harmonised European Commission CV template; a separate document per site

documents.signature_rule: The CTR imposes no general signature requirement; the EU CV template notes that a signature could be required only by national legislation, and the Polish sources reviewed establish no blanket signature requirement. Complete the current information and date fields.
documents.content: CV demonstrating the investigator's suitability. Personal details come from the investigator; the assistant fills only the trial fields.
documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja M. Obowiązkowy dla każdego badacza i ośrodka (osobny dokument dla każdego ośrodka). Polski lub angielski. Zharmonizowany szablon CV Komisji Europejskiej jest opcjonalny. CTR nie nakłada ogólnego wymogu podpisu, a polskie źródła nie ustanawiają odrębnego wymogu podpisu dla szablonu CV UE; wypełnić aktualne informacje i pola dat wymagane przez szablon. Dane osobowe dostarcza badacz: asystent wpisuje tylko numer badania UE i nie wymyśla danych osobowych.

documents.signature_rule: The EU template states that the CTR does not require signing individual application documents unless national law adds it; complete and date the declaration and follow any case-specific instruction from CTIS or the Polish assessor.
documents.content: Declaration for the principal or lead investigator at each site: economic, institutional or personal interests that could influence impartiality; investigator and institution identified; date field.
documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja M. Obowiązkowy dla badacza głównego lub prowadzącego w każdym ośrodku. Polski lub angielski. Szablon Komisji Europejskiej: interesy ekonomiczne, instytucjonalne i osobiste mogące wpływać na bezstronność, dane badacza i instytucji, pole daty. CTR nie wymaga podpisu, chyba że wprowadza go prawo krajowe; stosować się do szczególnych poleceń z CTIS lub polskiego oceniającego. Asystent wpisuje tylko tytuł badania i numer badania UE; resztę wypełnia badacz.

template.basis: Current European Commission site-suitability form, unless a Poland-specific instruction requires otherwise (Annex I point 67)

documents.note: The Poland guides state no Polish signature requirement for the CTIS copy; the shared form leaves the signature block empty unless the Member State requires one (DECISIONS.md, D11).
documents.content: For every Polish trial site: facilities, equipment, staffing and organisational arrangements needed for the protocol and the expected participant population. Submitted before site initiation because suitability is part of the Part II assessment.
documents.filled_by: assistant; site fields left empty for the site
documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja N. Obowiązkowy, jeden formularz na każdy polski ośrodek. Polski lub angielski. Aktualny formularz Komisji Europejskiej, chyba że polska instrukcja stanowi inaczej. Wykazać pomieszczenia, wyposażenie, personel i rozwiązania organizacyjne potrzebne dla protokołu i oczekiwanej populacji uczestników. Dane ośrodka (nazwa, badacz główny, planowana liczba uczestników, numer identyfikacyjny) pozostawić puste dla ośrodka. Przewodniki nie przewidują polskiego wymogu podpisu w egzemplarzu CTIS: blok podpisu pozostawić pusty (DECISIONS.md, D11).

documents.name_en: Proof of insurance or indemnification (sponsor and investigator civil liability insurance)
documents.unless: trial.low_intervention: statutory exception for the sponsor's insurance only; the investigator remains within the national liability framework
documents.signature_rule: Issued by the insurer; the guides set no signature rule.
documents.content: Polish law requires civil liability insurance of the sponsor and of the investigator for damage connected with the conduct of the trial. The obligation arises no later than the date the application is submitted; the Polish Act sets minimum guaranteed sums based on the number of participants. Use the current statutory text and insurer documentation. Attach before authorisation.
documents.note: Investigator cover issued as a separate certificate: see DECISIONS.md, D10 (proposed O2_Proof of coverage_<site>). Language of insurer documents: not stated in the guides.
documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja O. Obowiązkowy w zwykłej ścieżce. Dokument wystawia ubezpieczyciel; asystent go nie redaguje, tylko sprawdza. Polska ustawa o badaniach klinicznych wymaga ubezpieczenia odpowiedzialności cywilnej sponsora i badacza za szkody związane z prowadzeniem badania; wyjątek dotyczy sponsora w badaniu niskiej interwencji, badacz pozostaje w krajowym systemie odpowiedzialności. Obowiązek ubezpieczenia powstaje najpóźniej w dniu złożenia wniosku. Minimalne sumy gwarancyjne zależą od liczby uczestników: sprawdzić aktualny tekst ustawy i dokumenty ubezpieczyciela. Dane ubezpieczenia muszą być zgodne z informacją dla uczestnika.

documents.ctis_section: Form (proof-of-payment upload; location to be confirmed, DECISIONS.md D5)
documents.ctis_title: Proof of payment_Clinical Trials Compensation Fund_PL
documents.ctis_title_note: The naming guide gives no title for this Polish payment evidence; proof of payment uses the CTIS Forms section (naming guide). Plain descriptive title, to confirm.
documents.name_en: Clinical Trials Compensation Fund payment evidence
documents.content: Proof of the sponsor's payment to the Clinical Trials Compensation Fund (operated through the Patient Rights Ombudsman) for each application for authorisation; applies to applications submitted from 14 April 2023, including low-intervention trials. Application evidence, not a participant-signed document. The participant information separately explains the right to the Polish compensation mechanism.
documents.drafting_notes_pl: Dowód wpłaty na Fundusz Kompensacyjny Badań Klinicznych. Obowiązkowy dla każdego wniosku o pozwolenie złożonego od 14 kwietnia 2023 r., także w badaniu niskiej interwencji (Rzecznik Praw Pacjenta). Dokument potwierdzający płatność, nie dokument podpisywany przez uczestnika. Miejsce zamieszczenia w CTIS do potwierdzenia (DECISIONS.md, D5). Informacja dla uczestnika odrębnie wyjaśnia prawo do świadczenia z Funduszu.

template.basis: European Commission compensation template (used where appropriate, per the Poland checklist)

documents.content: Travel reimbursement, expense compensation or other payments participants may receive; state clearly when none is offered. Minors, incapacitated participants and pregnant or breastfeeding participants: only compensation for expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation. Healthy volunteers: reimbursement separate from payment for time or inconvenience; effect of withdrawal on payment explained.

national_fields.f04: Poland: if a monetary payment is offered (healthy volunteers), state the amount and its justification separately from reimbursement of expenses and do not present it as a guaranteed gain; do not rely on the NKB remuneration guidance revoked in 2026. Minors, incapacitated participants and pregnant or breastfeeding participants receive no payment beyond compensation for expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation.
national_fields.f06: Poland: state what happens to payment if the participant withdraws or is withdrawn (prorating), without forfeiting legitimate expense reimbursement; amounts and conditions identical to the participant documents.

documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja P. Obowiązkowy. Polski lub angielski; bez podpisu. Formularz rekompensaty Komisji Europejskiej stosować tam, gdzie jest właściwy; podać zwrot kosztów podróży, rekompensatę wydatków i inne płatności, a jeżeli nie ma płatności – wyraźnie to stwierdzić. Małoletni, uczestnicy niezdolni do wyrażenia zgody oraz kobiety w ciąży lub karmiące piersią: wyłącznie rekompensata wydatków i utraconych zarobków bezpośrednio związanych z udziałem. Zdrowi ochotnicy: oddzielić zwrot kosztów od wynagrodzenia za czas i niedogodności; wyjaśnić skutki wycofania (proporcjonalność); nie opierać się na uchylonych w 2026 r. wytycznych NKB dotyczących wynagradzania. Kwoty i warunki identyczne jak w dokumentach dla uczestników. Ustalenia finansowe z badaczem i ośrodkiem: PL-P2.

documents.name_en: Investigator and site financial arrangements and other relevant financial arrangements
documents.content: Part II must describe investigator and site financial arrangements and other relevant financial arrangements (Poland checklist item 11). The EU compensation form covers participants only, so this information is a separate sponsor document.
documents.note: The guides prescribe no format, granularity or signature rule (DECISIONS.md, D9).
documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja P. Obowiązkowa informacja: ustalenia finansowe z badaczem i ośrodkiem oraz inne istotne ustalenia finansowe. Dokument dostarcza sponsor (dział prawny lub finansowy); asystent tylko sprawdza jego zgodność z P1. Forma, podział na ośrodki i ewentualny podpis do potwierdzenia (DECISIONS.md, D9).

documents.ctis_section: Form (CTIS Form section, outside the Part II placeholders)
documents.ctis_title_note: The Poland checklist places the standard EC GDPR statement in the CTIS Form section; the naming guide gives it no CTCG title ("use other CTIS upload locations"). Any additional Poland-specific data-protection documentation in Part II would use R1_Compliance collection and use personal data_PL (DECISIONS.md, D7).

template.basis: European Commission standard GDPR compliance statement; the Poland guides require no national statement in it

documents.content: Statement or documentation showing compliance with applicable personal-data rules. Participant-facing privacy information used in Poland is in Polish and consistent with the actual data flows, recipients, retention and international transfers. Informed consent to participate and the GDPR legal basis are related but not interchangeable (EC CTR-GDPR Q&A).
documents.filled_by: assistant; name and role of the responsible person at the sponsor from the sponsor
documents.drafting_notes_pl: Formularz CTIS (sekcja Form): standardowe oświadczenie Komisji Europejskiej o zgodności z RODO. Polski lub angielski. Imię, nazwisko i funkcję osoby odpowiedzialnej po stronie sponsora podaje sponsor – nie wymyślać. Polskie przewodniki nie wymagają dodatkowego krajowego zdania w oświadczeniu: pole warunkowe r1_the_sponsor_declares nie ma zastosowania i zostaje usunięte (DECISIONS.md, D8). Polska informacja o ochronie danych dla uczestników musi odpowiadać rzeczywistym przepływom danych, odbiorcom, okresom przechowywania i transferom międzynarodowym; RODO stosuje się łącznie z ustawą z dnia 10 maja 2018 r. o ochronie danych osobowych. Świadoma zgoda na udział w badaniu nie jest podstawą prawną przetwarzania danych.

documents.ctis_title: S1_Compliance collection use storage biological samples_PL
documents.trigger_text: Standard Part II category when samples are collected, used or stored.

template.basis: European Commission Part II template for compliance with applicable rules for biological samples

documents.content: How biological samples are collected, used, stored and managed under applicable rules. Optional future research outside the protocol needs a clear separate participant choice; the form does not replace clear Polish participant information.
documents.drafting_notes_pl: CTIS część II, sekcja S. Warunkowy: gdy próbki biologiczne są pobierane, wykorzystywane lub przechowywane. Polski lub angielski; bez podpisu. Szablon Komisji Europejskiej. Treść zgodna z protokołem, planem próbek, PIS/ICF, oświadczeniem RODO i ewentualnym formularzem przyszłego wykorzystania. Przechowywanie do opcjonalnych badań poza protokołem wymaga wyraźnego, odrębnego wyboru uczestnika (szablon PL-PT-secondary). Sekcja 5 (dodatkowe wymogi krajowe): przewodniki nie wskazują dodatkowych polskich wymogów – nie dopisywać treści spoza źródeł.

documents.ctis_title_note: Proof of fee payment uses the CTIS Forms section, not a Part II placeholder (naming guide); no CTCG title is given. Plain descriptive title, to confirm (DECISIONS.md, D5).
documents.name_en: Application and ethics fee payment evidence
documents.unless: no fee applies to the application
documents.content: Poland charges a national clinical-trial application fee under the Clinical Trials Act. NKB states that proof of the payment made to the Medical Research Agency account for the application is uploaded in CTIS. URPL and NKB publish the current payment instructions; use the current fee page and do not copy an amount into standing material.
documents.drafting_notes_pl: Dowód wniesienia opłaty za złożenie wniosku. Obowiązkowy, jeżeli opłata dotyczy wniosku. Dowód wpłaty na rachunek Agencji Badań Medycznych zamieszcza się w CTIS (NKB). Korzystać z aktualnych instrukcji płatności URPL i NKB; nie przepisywać kwot do stałych materiałów.

fields.v105: Poland: in Polish, state how each recruitment item (K2) is used and how responses from people who are not eligible are handled; that material shown to potential participants in Poland is in Polish; who makes first contact and how personal data are accessed during pre-screening, consistent with K2; for healthy volunteers, how they are identified and approached.
fields.v108: Poland: in Polish, state that the Polish PIS and ICF are used; that written consent is dated and signed by the participant (or legally designated representative) and by the person conducting the consent interview on the approved version before enrolment or any trial-specific procedure, except under Article 35; that the participant or representative receives a copy; the PIS/ICF versions and dates referenced (identical to the uploaded L1 documents); that information before consent explains the right to seek a benefit from the Clinical Trials Compensation Fund and the mandatory civil liability insurance of the sponsor and investigator (Patient Rights Ombudsman); that optional choices are separate from main participation; and that trial consent is not presented as the GDPR legal basis for processing.
fields.v110: Poland, when incapacitated adults are included: in Polish, describe how incapacity for the trial decision is assessed and by whom; how the legally designated representative is identified and how their legal authority under Polish law is verified and documented at the site (family relationship alone is not legal authority; no generic hierarchy of relatives); which Polish documents the representative and the participant receive; how the participant's understanding and opinion are sought and an explicit refusal or withdrawal is respected; whether and when capacity is reassessed and how personal consent is obtained if capacity returns; how signatures and copies are managed; that only expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation are compensated.
fields.v114: Poland, when minors are included: in Polish, state the age groups, which document each group receives and who signs: under 13 the legal representative gives consent and the child receives age-appropriate information without a consent signature; from the 13th birthday until 18 the minor's own written consent is required together with the legal representative's consent (NKB good practice); age ranges are written in NKB notation ("13-18 lat" = has reached 13, has not reached 18). Where both parents hold parental authority, state how the joint parental decision is documented (both parents sign, or one parent signs with an attestation that the consent results from a joint decision with the other parent) and how authority is verified where only one person holds it or another legal arrangement applies. State that information is given by staff trained or experienced in working with minors; that an explicit refusal or withdrawal by a minor able to form an opinion is respected (Article 32), with guardianship-court involvement where Polish law provides it if minor and representative disagree; how verbal or behavioural dissent of younger children is handled; that the adolescent form is used when a child reaches 13 during the trial and adult re-consent is obtained at 18; and that optional secondary-use choices are made by the person legally entitled at that age.
fields.v117: Poland, when an impartial witness may be needed: in Polish, state that a participant or legally designated representative who can decide but cannot write gives consent by an approved alternative means in the presence of at least one impartial witness, who signs and dates the ICF (Article 29 CTR; NKB good practice); that the two-witness rule for certain medical experiments does not apply to CTR trials (Article 29b of the Act on the professions of physician and dentist); how the witness is selected and impartiality supported; that an interpreter is not automatically the witness; and, if planned, the alternative recording method (for example audiovisual recording of oral consent), what the witness observes and how the record is retained and protected.
fields.v121: Poland, when emergency enrolment is used: in Polish, describe the clinical circumstances that trigger Article 35; who confirms that the participant cannot consent or receive prior information; why the legally designated representative cannot be informed and consent within the therapeutic window; how a known prior objection is checked; how the emergency decision and its timing are documented; which Polish documents are used after the intervention; how consent for continued participation is sought without undue delay (who is contacted, how failed contact attempts are recorded); re-consent if the participant regains capacity; and what happens, including to data already collected, if subsequent consent is refused.

fields.f04: Poland: if a monetary payment is offered (healthy volunteers), state the amount and its justification separately from reimbursement of expenses and do not present it as a guaranteed gain; do not rely on the NKB remuneration guidance revoked in 2026. Minors, incapacitated participants and pregnant or breastfeeding participants receive no payment beyond compensation for expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation.
fields.f06: Poland: state what happens to payment if the participant withdraws or is withdrawn (prorating), without forfeiting legitimate expense reimbursement; amounts and conditions identical to the participant documents.

national_fields_note: Index of the national additions to shared forms; the same text is on each document (documents[].national_fields). Field ids are those of the shared <form>.fields.json. R1, N1 and S1 need no national addition in Poland.

outside_part_ii.requirement: mandatory for the application (CTR Q&A Annex II)
outside_part_ii.where: Part I (D1_Protocol synopsis_PL_<EU CT number>_pl, after the naming-guide pattern D1_Protocol synopsis_MS_EU CT number_LANGUAGE)
outside_part_ii.note: Participant-facing terminology must match the Polish study description.

outside_part_ii.what: Relevant CTIS application fields in Polish
Polish labelling, including labelling for an IMP not handed to the participant

population_sets.basis: Polish adult-patient SIS/ICF template (ABM-based, per the template's own instructions)

population_sets.note: Adults without the disease or condition studied. State the absence of therapeutic benefit; no treatment-benefit, standard-of-care or disease follow-up wording; healthy-volunteer burdens and restrictions per protocol; payment separate from reimbursement and from injury compensation; Polish Fund and insurance information as for all participants.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_children under 13_<population>_PL_pl
documents.when: children who have not reached 13 and can understand and take part in the decision (template drafted for 6 to 11; 12-year-olds: DECISIONS.md D2)

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_adolescents 13 to under 18_<population>_PL_pl
documents.when: from the 13th birthday until 18; also when a child reaches 13 during the trial

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_<population>_PL_pl (adult re-consent)
documents.when: participants who can reach 18 during the trial (healthy-volunteer template for healthy minors, if any)

population_sets.note: Under 13: the legal representative consents; the child receives age-appropriate information and takes part in the decision, without a legally binding child signature. From 13 to under 18: the minor's own consent together with the legal representative's consent. Joint parental decision where both parents hold parental authority. Explicit refusal or withdrawal of a minor able to form an opinion is respected. Adult re-consent at 18. Only expenses and loss of earnings compensated. CTIS title labels: DECISIONS.md D3.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_participant information limited capacity_<population>_PL_pl
L1_SIS and ICF_<population>_PL_pl (re-consent after regained capacity)
documents.when: capacity can return during the trial

population_sets.note: Article 31 conditions. Representative's legal authority verified under Polish law; no generic family-member signature line. The participant's adapted document is labelled as information or willingness, not as the legal consent. Main adult content (risks, procedures, alternatives, withdrawal, insurance, Fund, data protection, contacts) stays in the representative document.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_legal representative_<population>_PL_pl
documents.when: incapacity may continue after the intervention

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_participant information limited capacity_<population>_PL_pl
documents.when: the participant cannot yet make the legal decision but can understand some information

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_<population>_PL_pl (re-consent)
documents.when: the participant later becomes able to consent personally after representative consent

population_sets.note: All Article 35 conditions; not a general waiver of consent. Subsequent Article 29 consent for continued participation without undue delay; full information including Fund and insurance, not hidden in an appendix. The emergency template is written for adults (minors in emergency: DECISIONS.md D15). K1 section 6 describes the Polish procedure.

Only for a person able to decide but unable to write (participant or legally designated representative). One impartial witness signs and dates; no second witness line. Not for incapacity or language barriers; an interpreter is not automatically the witness.

When pregnancy triggers additional contacts, medical-record access, obstetric information, outcome collection or infant follow-up beyond what the main ICF clearly describes. Foreseeable pregnancy testing and reporting belong in the main PIS/ICF.

Separate Polish document written from the partner's perspective; the participant's consent does not cover the partner; the partner is a separate data subject and not a trial participant; do not copy participant compensation language. Infant data: the person legally able to permit collection for the child.

Article 28(2) optional scientific use outside the protocol, unmistakably separate from main participation; withdrawable at any time (never "irrevocable"). Choices follow the consent authority at the time (parent, legal representative, adolescent); new adult choice when a minor reaches 18 or capacity returns. Architecture: DECISIONS.md D13; genetic research: D14.

population_sets_note: population_sets list which templates a kind of population triggers; the actual populations are defined per study (playbook section 2a) and each population gets its own documents.
drafting_rules: All participant-facing documents for Poland are in Polish and prepared before submission; translation and linguistic QC are part of the dossier, not a site-start activity. Review the Polish text clinically, not only linguistically.

The PIS covers, where applicable: purpose and why the person is invited; procedures, randomisation, blinding, placebo or comparator; foreseeable risks and inconveniences including reproductive risks; expected benefits or a clear statement that no direct benefit is expected; alternatives; duration and follow-up; voluntariness, refusal and withdrawal without detriment; care after withdrawal; confidentiality, personal data, medical-record access and recipients; samples, storage and future use; reimbursement and payments; injury compensation and insurance in Poland; contacts; when the investigator or sponsor may stop participation. Describe what the protocol does rather than reproduce protocol wording.

Every participant document (main, healthy-volunteer, parent, adolescent, legal-representative, emergency, witness) explains the right to seek a benefit from the Clinical Trials Compensation Fund and the mandatory civil liability insurance of the sponsor and investigator, using the Patient Rights Ombudsman's recommended wording as reference; a generic insurance sentence is not equivalent. For healthy volunteers keep it separate from study payment. In pregnant-partner forms do not suggest the partner has trial-participant status under the scheme.
Keep the main participation decision separate from optional choices (future use, genetic research, recontact); make the consequence of saying no clear.

Signatures at consent (Article 29): the participant or legally designated representative and the person conducting the consent interview sign and date; the CTIS copy is blank; the participant receives a copy. Signature lines only for consent-givers and the consent-taker (and the impartial witness where that route applies).
Impartial witness: one witness (CTR, NKB); never two witness lines; the witness statement covers only what the witness observes.
Minors: NKB 13-year threshold; joint parental decision route; age bands written in NKB notation; no legally binding signature for children under 13.
Legally designated representative: describe and verify legal authority; never a generic family-member signature line.

Payments: minors, incapacitated and pregnant or breastfeeding participants receive only compensation for expenses and loss of earnings; for healthy volunteers separate reimbursement from payment, explain prorating on withdrawal, and do not rely on the NKB remuneration guidance revoked in 2026. Amounts identical to P1.

Data protection: GDPR together with the Polish Act of 10 May 2018 on the protection of personal data; trial consent is not presented as the GDPR legal basis; withdrawal does not imply deletion of all lawfully collected data; medical-record access names who may review and why; transfers outside Poland or the EEA described specifically.
Give risks with the frequency categories in the Polish templates (bardzo często, często, niezbyt często, rzadko), matching the IB or SmPC; the Poland guides set no categories of their own.
Keep defined terms consistent across PIS, ICF, recruitment material, pregnancy and future-use forms; version numbers and dates consistent with K1 and across CTIS.

Participant templates (JSON): italic text, coloured instructions (blue instructions, green examples, yellow comprehension questions, per each template's styling_instructions), examples marked "Przykład", [square-bracket] notes and gaps are drafting instructions; follow and remove them, together with the section "Informacje i instrukcje ogólne" and the ABM and PSBK logos. Part II forms (DOCX): yellow [INSERT/IF/OTHERWISE/CHOOSE/NOTE: …] labels. Nothing of either may remain in a final document.
sources_note: All eleven Poland guide pages reviewed 23 September 2026, read in full on 27 November 2026. '#n' refers to the numbered item on the Part II checklist page; '#language' to its section 'Poland language checks before upload'. Templates: CTIS_PL folder (Part II DOCX forms, Variable Templates_PL_de.xlsx, PL_Participant-facing_templates_05082026.txt).

naming.convention: content/playbook/naming.md (CTCG Best Practice Guide: Naming of Documents in CTIS, v3.0, 10 February 2026)
naming.poland_note: The Poland guides give descriptive document names, not CTIS titles; the CTCG examples are used. Participant documents carry _PL_pl. Minor age-band labels avoid ambiguity at the 13-year threshold (DECISIONS.md D3). Proof-of-payment uploads (fee, Compensation Fund) and the GDPR statement use the CTIS Form section and have no CTCG title.

document_kinds.form: Regulatory form the assistant answers question by question. Keep the template layout and questions unchanged.
document_kinds.participant_document: Participant- or representative-facing document written section by section from a participant template, for one population.
document_kinds.third_party_template: Template completed by someone else (investigator). The assistant fills only trial fields (title, EU trial number) and leaves every other field empty for that person.
document_kinds.third_party_document: Document issued by someone else (insurer, sponsor finance or legal, payment confirmation). Recorded as a source when received; only checked.
document_kinds.ctis_data: Information entered as structured data in CTIS; checked against the plan.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Adolescents
participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja o badaniu i formularz świadomej zgody na udział w badaniu klinicznym dla uczestnika małoletniego
participant_templates.role: information and the minor's own written informed consent, from the 13th birthday until 18
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adolescent participants (aged 12 - 17 years).
participant_templates.poland_rule: Use from the 13th birthday until the 18th (NKB 13-year threshold; the template's own content instructions say the same). Not for 12-year-olds: the supplied description and file name said 12-17 (conflict resolved in templates/README.md). Contains only the minor's and the consent-taker's signatures; the legal representative consents on PL-PT-parents.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Children
participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja o badaniu klinicznym dla uczestnika małoletniego
participant_templates.role: age-appropriate information only (no consent or assent form, no child signature) for children who have not reached 13
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving children participants (aged 6 - 11 years).
participant_templates.poland_rule: Drafted for children from 6 to the 12th birthday. Children under 13 do not sign a declaration of consent (NKB); the legal representative consents on PL-PT-parents. Use for 12-year-olds is a decision (DECISIONS.md, D2).

participant_templates.name_en: Emergency Enrolment and Deferred Consent Form
participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja i formularz odroczonej zgody na dalszy udział w badaniu klinicznym
participant_templates.role: information and consent for continued participation after emergency enrolment (adult; participant or legal representative pathway)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves emergency enrolment before prior informed consent because neither the participant nor a legal representative can provide consent within the required treatment window.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Healthy Adults
participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja dla zdrowego ochotnika i formularz świadomej zgody na udział w badaniu klinicznym
participant_templates.role: main information and consent (healthy adult volunteers)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving healthy adult volunteers aged 18 or older who are not recruited because of a diagnosed condition and who meet the protocol-defined health and eligibility criteria. Use for Phase I, first-in-human, bioavailability, bioequivalence, pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic or other studies in healthy adults when no more specific template applies.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Legal Representative
participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja dla przedstawiciela prawnego i formularz świadomej zgody na udział w badaniu klinicznym
participant_templates.role: information and consent for the legally designated representative of an adult who cannot consent
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves adult participants who cannot provide informed consent and participation must be authorised by a legally authorised representative.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Assent Form - Limited Capacity
participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja dla uczestnika i formularz wyrażenia woli udziału w badaniu klinicznym
participant_templates.role: information adapted to the capacity of an adult who cannot consent; records the participant's willingness or objection, not the legal consent
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves an adult lacking consent capacity who retains sufficient understanding to receive adapted information and express assent, willingness or objection. It accompanies the legal representative’s consent.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Adult Patients
participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja dla uczestnika i formularz świadomej zgody na udział w badaniu klinicznym
participant_templates.role: main information and consent (capable adult patients); also adult re-consent at 18 and after regained capacity
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving adult patients (18 or older & diagnosed with a specific health condition). Can be used for patients when no other template applies such as re-consent after reaching adulthood, regained capacity, prescreening, or optional substudies or extension arms.

participant_templates.name_en: Trial Information and Consent Form - Parents
participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja dla przedstawiciela ustawowego i formularz świadomej zgody na udział dziecka w badaniu klinicznym
participant_templates.role: information and consent for the parent(s) or other statutory representative of a minor
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be completed for studies involving minor participants (younger than 18 years).

participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja i formularz świadomej zgody na obserwację ciąży i zdrowia dziecka
participant_templates.role: pregnancy and infant follow-up of a pregnant trial participant beyond the main consent
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves collection of pregnancy outcome, maternal-health or infant-health information from a pregnant trial participant.

participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja i formularz świadomej zgody na obserwację ciąży partnerki uczestnika badania oraz zdrowia dziecka
participant_templates.role: information and consent for the pregnant partner of a participant (separate data subject, not a trial participant)
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves collection of pregnancy outcome, maternal-health or infant-health information from the pregnant partner of a male trial participant.

participant_templates.name_en: Secondary and Future Use of Data or Biosamples
participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja i formularz świadomej zgody na przyszłe wykorzystanie danych i materiału biologicznego do badań naukowych
participant_templates.role: optional scientific use of data or samples outside the protocol (Article 28(2)), separate from main participation
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves optional storage or secondary use of participant data, biological samples or genetic material beyond the mandatory purposes of the main clinical trial.

participant_templates.name_en: Subject Information and Consent Form - Impartial Witness
participant_templates.name_pl: Informacja dla uczestnika i formularz świadomej zgody – wersja z udziałem bezstronnego świadka
participant_templates.role: consent recorded by alternative means in the presence of one impartial witness, for a capable participant who cannot write
participant_templates.when_to_use: Must be used when the study involves an adult participant who has capacity to consent but cannot read, write or sign the standard consent form. The participant decides personally, while an impartial witness confirms and documents the consent process.
participant_templates.poland_rule: Planned when the person giving consent cannot write (Article 29 CTR, NKB); one impartial witness. Inability to read alone does not trigger this route (conflict resolved in templates/README.md).

population_rules.authority: NKB (National Bioethics Committee for Clinical Trials) current good practices for reviewing teams (2026 set; predecessor guidance revoked), Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 Articles 28 to 35, the Polish Act on clinical trials of medicinal products for human use of 9 March 2023 (consolidated text Journal of Laws 2026 item 2), Article 29b of the Act on the professions of physician and dentist, and the Patient Rights Ombudsman's information for sponsors, as recorded in the Poland guides reviewed 23 September 2026.

age_bands.consent: legal representative only; child information without signature
legal representative only; age-appropriate information without a child consent signature (parents template rule)
age_bands.note: No supplied template is drafted for 12-year-olds; default pending DECISIONS.md D2.

age_bands.consent: minor's own written consent together with the legal representative's consent

minors.threshold: NKB: under 13 the legal representative gives consent; from the 13th birthday until 18 consent of both the minor and the legal representative is required. The supplied adolescent template was labelled 12-17; the authority's threshold of 13 wins.
minors.band_notation: NKB: a range written as 13-18 years means the participant has reached 13 but has not yet reached 18. Polish document labels use this notation; file names in this repository use inclusive ranges (13-17 = 13th to 18th birthday).
minors.joint_parental_decision: Where both parents hold parental authority, participation is an important matter for a joint parental decision (NKB). Document it either by both parents signing the ICF or by one parent signing with an attestation that the consent is the result of a joint decision with the other parent. Build one route into the parent ICF (DECISIONS.md D4). Where one person alone holds authority or another legal arrangement applies, verify the actual legal authority before consent.
minors.disagreement: The representative's signature does not override the minor; guardianship-court involvement applies under Polish law, and an explicit refusal of a minor able to form an opinion is respected (Article 32).
minors.reconsent_at_13: PL-PT-age-13-17 before continued participation when a child reaches 13 during the trial (template instructions; follows the NKB threshold).
minors.reconsent_at_18: PL-PT-main (or PL-PT-healthy) before continued participation when the participant reaches 18 (Article 32(3)); track birthdays.
minors.under_6: No template. Involve the child in a way adapted to age and maturity and record their response; dissent is respected (DECISIONS.md D16).
minors.assent_signature: No legally binding child signature under 13. The guide allows an assent signature as an ethical record only if labelled as assent and kept distinct; the supplied child template excludes any signature or assent form, and is used as supplied.
minors.payment: Only compensation for expenses and loss of earnings directly related to participation.

adults_without_capacity.note: Article 31: consent of the legally designated representative before enrolment (unless Article 35 applies) and information adapted to the participant's capacity, which is an active, mandatory part of the process. The representative's legal authority under Polish law is verified and documented; family relationship alone is not authority. Capacity reassessment and personal consent when capacity returns (PL-PT-main). A combined participant and representative document is acceptable only if it stays clear who is informed, who consents and which signature records which decision.

conditional.PL-PT-limited-capacity: participant can understand some information but cannot yet decide
conditional.PL-PT-main: re-consent when the participant regains capacity

emergency.note: Article 35 conditions all met; consent for continued participation sought without undue delay; refusal of subsequent consent is not overridden by the first intervention.

impartial_witness.note: One impartial witness (Article 29 CTR; NKB). The two-witness rule for medical experiments does not apply. Trigger: the person giving consent cannot write.

pregnancy.participant: PL-PT-pregnancy when follow-up goes beyond the main ICF
pregnancy.partner: PL-PT-pregnant-partner whenever identifiable partner health information or records are collected

population_rules.shareable_note: Shared across populations only when nothing in the document would differ. The secondary-use document must follow the signer route of each population (participant, parent, legal representative), so it is shared only among populations with the same signer route.
separate_document_rules: Do not combine distinct consent populations into one form if that makes the signature logic unclear; parent, adolescent and adult documents are separate controlled documents where the consent-givers differ.
Optional secondary or future use (Article 28(2)) is kept unmistakably separate from main participation; the supplied templates put it in its own form (PL-PT-secondary).
A separate optional genetic or genomic research choice where its scope differs materially (DECISIONS.md D14).
A pregnant partner receives a separate partner-facing information and consent document; the participant cannot consent for the partner.
A separate pregnancy follow-up document when pregnancy triggers contacts, record access or outcome and infant follow-up beyond the main ICF.
Emergency enrolment: Polish documents for continued participation after the intervention; never an unsigned 'emergency consent form' presented as prior consent.
